title: Hot Tub Cover in Black 210D – Keeps Leaves and Debris Out
seo_title: Hot Tub Cover 215 cm – Round Cover in Black 210D
seo_description: Round hot tub cover in black 210D fabric, diameter 215 cm and height 70 cm. A drawstring in the hem keeps the cover in place between soaks.
descriptionHtml:
The leaves already on their way toward the water

One gust of wind is enough for needles and leaves to swirl straight down into the open tub, and it's that moment between soaks that stresses you most – not the discovery afterwards. You want to be able to walk away without wondering what's floating around in the water when you come back.

A round cover that seals off the surface

The cover in black 210D fabric is laid over the entire round surface, up to 215 cm in diameter and 70 cm high. The drawstring in the edge is tightened around the bottom edge so the cover stays in place between soaks.

Features

  • Leaves and debris are kept out of the water – the cover spans the whole round surface, diameter 215 cm.
  • Stays put even in wind – the drawstring in the edge is tightened around the bottom edge of the cover.
  • Fits a hot tub up to 215 cm in diameter – the width of the cover is set for that maximum size.
  • Fits a hot tub up to 70 cm high – the height of the cover covers the sides of the tub all the way down.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.
